metadata.title: CYBER-BRIDGE Requirement Catalogue - NIS2 Article 21(2) (Cybersecurity risk-management measures)

controls.title: Documented policy on the security of network and information systems

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have a documented policy on the security of network and information systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have a documented policy on risk analysis covering the identification, analysis and evaluation of risks to network and information systems.

controls.title: All-hazards approach reflected in the policies

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The policies shall be based on an all-hazards approach that protects network and information systems and the physical environment of those systems from incidents.

controls.title: Technical, operational and organisational measures addressed

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The policies shall address technical, operational and organisational measures, and shall not be limited to any one of those categories.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The policies shall be reviewed and, where necessary, updated, so that they continue to reflect the risks to which the entity is exposed.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have a documented procedure for handling incidents affecting network and information systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The procedure shall provide for the detection and recording of incidents.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The procedure shall provide for the assessment, classification and prioritisation of incidents.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The procedure shall provide for response to and containment of incidents.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall review incidents after closure and apply the resulting lessons to its measures.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have business continuity arrangements for the services it provides.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall manage backups of data and systems necessary to restore its services.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall test the restoration of backups so that their effectiveness is established rather than assumed.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have disaster recovery arrangements enabling the resumption of services after a disruptive event.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have crisis management arrangements, distinct from business continuity, covering decision-making and communication during a crisis.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall exercise its continuity, recovery and crisis management arrangements at planned intervals.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have measures addressing the security of its supply chain.

controls.title: Security in relationships with direct suppliers

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The measures shall address the security-related aspects of the relationships between the entity and each of its direct suppliers.

controls.title: Security in relationships with service providers

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The measures shall address the security-related aspects of the relationships between the entity and each of its direct service providers.

controls.title: Supplier vulnerabilities and practices taken into account

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall take into account the vulnerabilities specific to each direct supplier and service provider and the overall quality of their products and cybersecurity practices.

controls.title: Supply chain measures maintained over the relationship

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall maintain its supply chain security measures over the life of the relationship, not only at the point of procurement.

controls.title: Security in the acquisition of network and information systems

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have security measures governing the acquisition of network and information systems.

controls.title: Security in the development of network and information systems

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have security measures governing the development of network and information systems.

controls.title: Security in the maintenance of network and information systems

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have security measures governing the maintenance of network and information systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have a process for handling vulnerabilities in the network and information systems it uses.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have arrangements for the disclosure of vulnerabilities it identifies or receives.

controls.title: Security testing before entry into service

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall apply security testing to systems before they enter service and after significant change.

controls.title: Policy for assessing the effectiveness of measures

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of its cybersecurity risk-management measures.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The assessment shall be carried out at planned intervals rather than only in response to an incident.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The results of the assessment shall be recorded and shall inform changes to the measures.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall apply basic cyber hygiene practices across its operations.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall provide cybersecurity training to its personnel.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Training shall be adapted to the roles held, so that personnel with elevated access or responsibilities receive correspondingly specific instruction.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Training shall be repeated at planned intervals and participation shall be recorded.

controls.title: Policy on the use of cryptography

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have policies and procedures regarding the use of cryptography.

controls.title: Policy on the use of encryption where appropriate

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The policies shall address the use of encryption where appropriate to the risk.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall manage cryptographic keys over their life cycle, including generation, storage, rotation and destruction.

controls.title: Cryptographic choices reviewed against the state of the art

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall review its cryptographic choices against the state of the art and adjust them where they no longer provide adequate protection.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have human resources security measures covering personnel before, during and on termination of employment.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall have an access control policy governing access to network and information systems.

controls.title: Access rights granted on a least-privilege basis

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access rights shall be granted on the basis of what each role requires, and no more.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access rights shall be reviewed at planned intervals and on change of role.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access rights shall be withdrawn without undue delay when the basis for them ends.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall maintain an inventory of the assets used to provide its services and shall assign responsibility for each.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall use multi-factor authentication or continuous authentication solutions where appropriate to the risk.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall use secured voice communications within the entity where appropriate to the risk.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall use secured video communications within the entity where appropriate to the risk.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall use secured text communications within the entity where appropriate to the risk.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The entity shall use secured emergency communication systems within the entity, available when ordinary channels are unavailable.
